title: The Book of Mormon
altTitles: Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ
author: joseph-smith
attributionNote: Latter-day Saints regard the Book of Mormon as scripture translated by Joseph Smith from ancient records. Its origins are a matter of religious claim and historical debate. This catalogue does not adjudicate that claim.
description: A foundational scripture for Latter-day Saint movements, narrating peoples of the ancient Americas and presenting itself as another testament of Jesus Christ. Editions, headings and study aids differ among Restorationist bodies.
historicalContext: First published in 1830 in Palmyra, New York. The text has been reprinted in many editions with changes in chapter divisions, punctuation and some wording; edition provenance matters.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Official LDS website terms permit personal noncommercial use but not website posting or automated copying without permission. Project Gutenberg #17 is public domain in the U.S. but is not a verified 1830 first-edition transcription, so it is not imported.
